comment: Stores the metadata for an MPEG audio frame.

variables.name: frameSize
variables.comment: Size of the frame associated with this header, in bytes.

variables.name: sampleRate
variables.comment: Sample rate in samples per second.

variables.name: channels
variables.comment: Number of audio channels in the frame.

variables.name: bitrate
variables.comment: Bitrate of the frame in bit/s.

variables.name: samplesPerFrame
variables.comment: Number of samples stored in the frame.

methods.name: public boolean setForHeaderData(int headerData)
methods.comment:
* Populates the fields in this instance to reflect the MPEG audio header in {@code headerData},
     * returning whether the header was valid. If false, the values of the fields in this instance
     * will not be updated.
     *
     * @param headerData Header data to parse.
     * @return True if the fields were populated. False otherwise, indicating that {@code
     *     headerData} is not a valid MPEG audio header.
